w: Cairns' first Catholic cathedral, built in 1927 by Michael Garvey to a design by Lawrence and Lordan, lost its altar once a newer cathedral rose nearby. Deconsecrated and heritage-listed since 1997, it now holds diocese and parish offices instead of a congregation.
s: Cairns' first cathedral, now empty of its congregation.
_facts: Heritage-listed former Roman Catholic cathedral at Minnie Street, Cairns City
Designed by Lawrence and Lordan, built in 1927 by Michael Garvey
Also known as St Monica's Cathedral and St Monica's Church & School
Added to the Queensland Heritage Register on 1 July 1997
Deconsecrated after a new St Monica's Cathedral was completed nearby; now repurposed as offices for the Diocese of Cairns and the local parish
